name: lflsf LF6: a label-free SIDE-EFFECT failure set for the latent safety filter (scene changed away from what the robot does) instead of the fragility margin
registered: 2026-10-25 20:23 EDT (commit dd9352a), before any LF6 margin net or value is trained and before any LF6 episode; after the exploratory analyses below
motivation: Exploratory (scratchpad an/noise_trig.py, an/margin_choice.py, an/sidefx*.py; held-out paired_record_m3 + the LF1 training runs): (1) the LF1 / LF5 fragility margin (hold-fork spread) is NOT a failure set: it scores states AFTER a topple as safe (AUC 0.226 for post-topple vs safe-episode states at 8x: a fallen scene is calm), and it flags ~10-13% of safe-episode states incl. the grasp; the value therefore learns to avoid fragility (the task) rather than topples. Execution noise is not the cause (hold-command trigger share on safe-episode states, label-free value eps 0: 10.2 / 11.2 / 12.9% at exec noise 0 / 1 / 2x; labelled value eps 0.30: 1.4 / 2.1 / 3.5%). (2) A side-effect statistic is: c(z_k) = 98th percentile over the 28x28 patches of mean_channels |z_k - z_0| (z_0 = the episode's first decision): post-topple vs safe AUC 0.992 (train) / 0.989 (m3); never above threshold before a topple starts; 0 on safe states with the red block lifted. Label-free threshold thr = the 98th percentile of c over decisions before the gripper first closes (nothing touched yet; proprio only), s = half the IQR of that reference: post-topple flagged 75.6 / 72.7%, safe-episode states 0.90 / 0.89%, safe gripper-closed 1.6 / 1.7% (train / m3). This mirrors relative-reachability / side-effect safety (do not change what you do not act on), and it is absorbing, as a reachability failure set must be.
stage_LF6a_margin: eval/lflsf.py margin with LF_TARGET=se: margin net l_hat(z) (the LF1 architecture, proprio zeroed, state only, NO z_0 input) regressed on t = tanh((thr - c) / s) with thr / s from the training runs' pre-grasp reference as above; training runs and held-out set as LF1 (TRAIN = paired_record_s4/h2h2/ocl + paired_cbfg_s4/h2h2; HELD = paired_record_m3) -> results/program_b/lsf_v1/margin_lfse.pt, results/jenga/lflsf_LF1_se.json.
gate_LF6a: held out (m3; note m3 was used in the exploratory choice of the statistic, not of the net): Spearman(l_hat, t) >= 0.6 AND AUC(-l_hat; post-topple decisions (chunk >= topple start + 1) vs safe-episode decisions) >= 0.90 AND share of safe-episode decisions with l_hat < 0 <= 3% AND share of post-topple decisions with l_hat < 0 >= 50%. FAIL -> one pre-declared variant: the net gets z_0 as extra input channels (requires carrying z_0 in the value; registered then), else stop the line.
stage_LF6b_value: LSF stage 2 recipe unchanged (UNISafe SAC in model_OIL imagination, ALEA 8, 60k updates) with LSF_CLF=margin_lfse.pt -> value_lfse_alea.pt. May train on the second local GPU (RTX 5080, same code at the registered commit); the dev episodes run on the RTX 3090 as all LF arms.
gate_LF6b: the LF2 / stage 2 offline gate unchanged (eval/lsf_audit.py + lsf_diag): actor saturated < 5%, median imagined V after the actor's plan >= after hold, AUROC of -V vs any toppling future >= 0.70. FAIL -> stop.
stage_LF6c_dev: closed loop, the LSF / LF3 dev protocol: episodes 15000-15099, paired with paired_record_lflsfdev, 2x execution noise, HARD_OFF, local RTX 3090, tag _lfsedev, LSF_VALUE_NAME=value_lfse_alea.pt. Arms: lfa010, lfa030, lfa050 (absolute switch, the LSF stage 2 grid, since this margin has the labelled classifier's semantics) and lfc030 (the LF4 latent-CBF edit at eps 0.30). Runs after the LF5 dev arms (never two GPU pools at once).
selection: over ALL lflsf arms (LF3, LF4, LF5, LF6): the LSF dev rule (fewest replay-audited neighbour topples among arms with v4 >= policy - 5 pp); ties -> fewer overrides per episode. v4 and v4b both reported. Exploratory dev selection; the selected arm then goes to a separately pre-registered fresh-episode head-to-head vs LSF stage 2 (labelled, lsfa030) and psel (cbfps3m).
secondary: overrides per episode; when they act (before first grasp / grasp to extraction / after extraction)
red falls before / after extraction, time-outs
comparison of v4 / topples with the labelled LSF stage 2 dev arms (lsfadev, same episodes, Fir)
scope: label-free (topple labels for grading / dev selection only), task-agnostic (the failure set is 'the scene changed where the robot did not act', state-only margin, proprio only to define the pre-contact reference), off-the-shelf DINOv2 latent model_OIL.
amendment_1: 2026-10-25 20:24 EDT, before any LF6 value training or episode: the value trains on the local RTX 3090 only (user: do not use the RTX 5080), queued after the LF5 value training; stage_LF6b's 'may train on the second local GPU' is void.
